creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The general form of the fix `a_2KHGYMpnK` did not build. That card put a ceiling on the grid, which covers one cause of a frozen pane - a frame too big for herdr to send. It does not cover the rest.

The bridge already counts `bridge.frames`. A pane whose bridge has relayed input and received no frame for a few seconds, while the daemon still answers, has stopped whatever its state says - and today `muster window` reports it `idle` and the roster says nothing.

Deliberately left out of `a_2KHGYMpnK` because detecting the grid names the oversized case the moment it happens and can say why, where silence is only ever a symptom. This is the wider net under it.
title: 🔇 A pane whose frames stopped arriving says nothing
